title: Mirror Trading International LocalBitcoins, you and your Bitcoin
description: An introduction to Bitcoin, using the LocalBitcoins website and Mirror Trading International Click the link if you wanna join up ...

asr.full_text: You, your Bitcoin and Mirror Trading International Bitcoin is a cryptocurrency, this is a decentralized digital currency without a central bank or a single administrator that can be sent on the peer-to-peer Bitcoin network, known as the blockchain without the need for intermediaries It can be bought and sold for your local currency at an exchange An example of an exchange is local bitcoins Let's look at an example of how this works. You register online with Local Bitcoins and once you are verified you can look for the best price in your local currency and you can choose a trader has the same bank as you to speed up the process. The system is designed to protect you and seller and Bitcoin will only be released once you have made the payment and the seller has confirmed receipt of the payment. The system holds the Bitcoin you are buying safe so that the seller cannot disappear with your money and the bitcoin you have just bought. The common misconception about Bitcoin is that you have to buy a whole Bitcoin. Bitcoins are divided into bits, also called Satoshioshi much like currencies have sense Once is 0.00001001 bitcoins or 100 millionth of a Bitcoin Once you have your bitcoin or portion thereof you can decide what you would like to do some people keep the Bitcoin in their wallets and wait for the price to go up these people are called hodlers. Mirror Trading International The goal of Mirror Trading International is to Grow your Bitcoin! How does Mirror Trading International grow my bitcoin? You become a member of the club, and send your bitcoin to the Trading Pool, which is controlled by the brokers. Daily your bitcoin will be in trade on the forex markets using advanced software that trades and you will receive a statement the following day of the trading results. The historical results of the trading have reduced around 10-12% per month. Historical results are not a guarantee of future results. With Mirror Trading International your bitcoin is growing and you can withdraw your bitcoin at any time. Once you have your bitcoin, you can then sell it via your local bitcoins account, and get the money directly into your bank account. That is the simple process of Bitcoin and mirror trading international. Should you have any questions, please contact the person who sent you this video.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Mirror Trading International by asking viewers to join and send Bitcoin to a broker-controlled trading pool for purported forex trading through a linked invitation. It claims that no trading knowledge is needed and that historical results were 10% to 12% monthly, presenting a concrete investment-return proposition. The video includes a non-guarantee disclaimer and describes withdrawals through LocalBitcoins, while the results, withdrawal functionality, join-link destination, and any completed transaction or loss are not established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content describes participation in a Bitcoin trading pool controlled by brokers, with the Bitcoin traded on forex markets and linked to a stated Bitcoin-growth outcome and historical monthly results. This supports a managed investment-pool return mechanism. The displayed results are explicitly historical and qualified as not guaranteed future results.
